name: S&P 500 Put Expiration Timing
claim: Returns from shorting out-of-the-money S&P 500 put options are concentrated in the few days before expiration.
quote: We document empirically that the returns from shorting out-of-the-money S&P 500 put options are concentrated in the few days preceding their expiration.

rules.timeframe: last days of the front-month option cycle
rules.entry: Short out-of-the-money front-month put options during the last days of the cycle; exact entry not stated

claimed_result: Returns are concentrated in the few days preceding expiration; a numerical value is not stated.

name: Goldman Roll Spread Pressure
claim: WTI calendar spreads narrowed during the commodity index roll window. The paper describes entering a short near-month and long deferred-month spread before the roll and unwinding it during the roll.
quote: The only difference is that Strategy 1 front-runs the Goldman roll by 10 business days, while Strategy 2 front-runs it by just 5 business days.
mechanism: Predictable index roll order flow pressures the spread between maturing and deferred futures.

rules.market: S&P GSCI energy futures, including WTI crude oil
rules.timeframe: Daily; positions held for 5 or 10 business days
rules.entry: Short the maturing contract and buy the deferred contract 5 or 10 business days before the corresponding roll date.
rules.exit: Unwind the spread on the corresponding index roll date.
rules.filters: Trade when the S&P GSCI rolls the commodity.

claimed_result: For 2000–2010, the paper reports 4.43% unlevered annual excess return for its energy portfolio under the 10-day strategy. For WTI, the reported difference between average roll yields in the first and last five days of the 15-day window was 0.47 percentage points.
required_data: S&P GSCI roll calendar and contract schedule

name: Funding Settlement Spot Spread
claim: Cryptocurrency spot quoted spreads are wider around perpetual futures funding times within the eight-hour funding cycle.
quote: Market makers respond to heightened adverse selection risk by widening quoted spreads.
mechanism: Funding settlement is associated with increased informed trading and wider spot bid-ask spreads.

rules.timeframe: Eight-hour perpetual funding cycle; hourly observations

claimed_result: Spot trading volume and percentage quoted spreads are larger around funding times than during normal hours.
required_data: Cryptocurrency spot bid and ask quotes

name: Dealer Gamma Intraday Price Dynamics
claim: Positive market-maker inventory gamma is associated with stronger intraday price reversal, while negative inventory gamma is associated with stronger intraday momentum in the S&P 500.
quote: We also show evidence suggesting that positive (negative) Market Makers’ inventory gamma strengthens intraday price reversal (momentum).
mechanism: Market makers' delta hedging of options inventory
claimed_result: Positive inventory gamma strengthens intraday reversal; negative inventory gamma strengthens intraday momentum.

name: S&P 500 option-expiration week effect
claim: S&P 500 returns averaged higher during weeks ending on the third Friday of the month than across all weeks.
quote: We nd that the mean return for the third Friday week is 37 basis points, more than double the average return for the full sample average of 15 basis points for all weeks.

rules.timeframe: Weekly, Friday to Friday; use the preceding available trading day when Friday prices are unavailable
rules.filters: Week ending on the third Friday of the month

claimed_result: July 1983–December 2008: mean third-Friday-week return was approximately 0.37%, versus 0.15% across all weeks; the reported spread versus other weeks was approximately 0.28 percentage points.

name: Bollinger Band Squeeze Breakout
claim: Narrow price action and shrinking Bollinger Bands indicate falling volatility, which IG says is often followed by a sharp rise; traders look for a significant breakout.
quote: Traders in this situation look for a significant breakout to signal a directional surge.

rules.market: Almost any market; specific FX cross not stated
rules.entry: Look for a significant breakout after narrow price action and shrinking Bollinger Bands; exact entry not stated
rules.filters: Narrow price action and shrinking Bollinger Bands; thresholds not stated

claimed_result: Falling volatility is often followed by a sharp rise; no quantified result stated.

name: Bitcoin futures expiration week
claim: Bitcoin returns were positive in 65% of weeks containing a futures expiration and averaged five times the returns of usual weeks.
quote: The only case in which an anomaly was detected was related to abnormally high returns during the week of expiration: returns during such weeks were positive in 65% of cases, and were on average 5 times higher than during usual weeks.

rules.filters: Week containing a bitcoin futures expiration

claimed_result: In 2018–2021, 31 of 48 expiration weeks had positive returns; the paper reports a Sharpe ratio of 1.05 for its weekly simulation.

name: Option Expiration Week Effect
claim: Quantpedia describes a long S&P 500 timing strategy around the monthly option-expiration week.
quote: The research suggests that stocks with large market capitalization, that have actively traded options, tend to have substantially higher average weekly returns during these weeks.

rules.market: S&P 500, using SPY in the source
rules.timeframe: Daily closes; approximately one week holding time
rules.entry: Buy at the close on the Friday before the second Saturday of each month.
rules.exit: Sell at the close on the following Thursday.

claimed_result: For 1993–2019, the source reports 4.93% annual performance and 20.39% maximum drawdown for the SPY strategy.
required_data: S&P 500 index or index CFD price history

name: Quarterly Expiration Week Returns
claim: The S&P 500 averaged a loss during weeks containing quarterly triple-witching expirations.
quote: The S&P 500 has averaged a 0.53% loss during these weeks with 53% of the returns positive.

rules.filters: Weeks containing the third Friday of March, June, September or December

claimed_result: Average weekly return of -0.53%; 53% of weeks positive, using data since 2017.

name: Monthly Options Expiration Week
claim: Hold the S&P 500 during monthly options expiration week.
quote: Note that if we enter at the close of the trading week preceding the options expiration week, the average gain increases to 0.35% per trade.

rules.timeframe: Daily; approximately one week holding time
rules.entry: Buy at the expiration week's Monday open or the preceding week's close.
rules.exit: Close on expiration day, usually Friday; Thursday if Friday is a holiday.

claimed_result: Average gain of 0.35% per trade with entry at the preceding week's close; test period stated as after 1990.
required_data: S&P 500 index open and close prices

name: Nikkei ex-dividend recovery
claim: The Nikkei 225 shows an average recovery over the five business days after an ex-rights date.
quote: According to historical data, the average scenario is a recovery of about +0.7% within 5 business days after the ex-rights date.
mechanism: Dividend-related selling and subsequent reinvestment or dip buying
claimed_result: Average recovery of about 0.7% within five business days after the ex-rights date, based on eight occurrences from 2024 through June 2026.

name: Bitcoin high-funding fade
claim: Short Bitcoin when the last settled eight-hour funding rate exceeds 0.05%, and exit after seven days.
quote: BTC: short when funding > 0.05%, hold 7 days — +6.89%

rules.entry: Short when the last settled eight-hour funding rate is above 0.05%.

claimed_result: The BTCUSDT perpetual futures backtest reports +6.89% return, 63.97% maximum drawdown and 42 trades from 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-01. It includes fees, slippage and funding payments; these are not CFD results.

name: Bitcoin negative-funding long
claim: Buy Bitcoin when the last settled eight-hour funding rate is negative, and exit after seven days.
quote: BTC: long when funding < 0, hold 7 days — +333.12%

rules.entry: Go long when the last settled eight-hour funding rate is below zero.

claimed_result: The BTCUSDT perpetual futures backtest reports +333.12% return, 40.84% maximum drawdown and 155 trades from 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-01. It includes fees, slippage and funding payments; these are not CFD results.

name: Bitcoin top-decile funding weakness
claim: Bitcoin funding in the top decile of its own historical distribution was followed by a negative median 72-hour return.
quote: On BTC, top-decile funding was followed by a negative median return at 72 hours and a hit rate well below chance.

rules.entry: Funding reaches or exceeds the 90th percentile of its own history; a trade entry is not stated.
rules.exit: Price effect measured after 72 hours; a trade exit is not stated.
rules.filters: Funding percentile calculated using data available at the observation time.

claimed_result: Across 37 non-overlapping episodes from 2024-05-15 to 2026-07-13, the median 72-hour Bitcoin return was −1.18%; 40.5% of episodes ended higher.
